_comment: Hand-maintained. Keys are Maxroll's class ids, which are the game's own class enum: 0 Primalist, 1 Mage, 2 Sentinel, 3 Acolyte, 4 Rogue. passiveTreeByClass maps them to the treeID in passives.json. masteriesByClass uses per-class mastery ids 1-3 in the game's order; mastery 0 = no mastery yet (plain class). Proven by real planners in tests/fixtures (each build's passive history fits only its class's tree): Mage (1, mastery 2 = Spellblade), Sentinel (2, mastery 3 = Paladin), Rogue (4, 1 = Bladedancer, 2 = Marksman). unverifiedMasteries lists class:mastery pairs never seen in a real export.
